 Third Avenue PlayWorks Brings ‘It’s a Wonderful Life’ to the Stage in December
 Nov 15, 2026 | 6:00 PM 
 Local News , Ryan Brahm 
 Third Avenue PlayWorks has begun rehearsals for its December show, “It’s a Wonderful Life: Live in Door County.”
 With the helpful assistance of a multi-talented musician and foley artist, the top-notch ensemble of actors once again brings the lovable and irascible residents of Bedford Falls to captivating life in this staged 1940s radio broadcast where you are the live studio audience.
 Director Samantha Martinson said of the production, “There’s something enduring about It’s a Wonderful Life – a parable for us all, reminding us that our lives are woven together in ways we don’t always recognize. I’m grateful we get to share this story with you, and I hope it offers a moment to pause and perhaps recognize the wonderful life all around you.” 
 The final show of the 2026 season at TAP runs from December 2 through December 27.
 For more details, visit ThirdAvenuePlayWorks.org .
